subject: Latency SLO proofpoint & audit playbook
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@orchidfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Hosted API latency SLO proofpoints & audit playbook

Hi Aditya / Lauren,

As part of Orchid's security and vendor review, our compliance team has asked for a concrete set of deliverables showing how Redwood measures, enforces, and audits latency SLOs for the hosted API. We are preparing a formal supplier audit and need the following by end of next week if possible: 

- The current live p50 / p95 commitments for the hosted API (per-region) and the precise measurement window used for each percentile.
- A short playbook describing how you generate "proofpoints" for an audit (what data is exported, retention/TTL, and how to reproduce a percentile calculation).
- Historical evidence (time series or summary) demonstrating rolling compliance for the last 90 days for our primary region (us-west).
- A proposed contractual addendum clause we can share with our legal team that covers temporary carveouts or mitigation steps during regional incidents.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items and share any templates you use? Our audit kickoff is 2028-03-29, so timing is tight.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Cloud Ops
Orchid Financial

---

(Attachment stubs referenced: orchid_audit_request_032028.pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@orchidfin.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API latency SLO proofpoints & audit playbook

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you outlined. High-level answers up front and a proposed delivery plan below. Attaching our draft playbook and a sample historical export.

Quick summary (live commitments for hosted API, us region):
- p50: 55 ms (per-request, per-route median)
- p95: 320 ms (per-request, per-route 95th percentile)
- Measurement granularity: quantile snapshots every 5 minutes computed across a sliding 60-minute window; daily aggregation for reporting and rolling 90-day compliance windows.
- Scope: per-route, per-region, and per-customer-tier (public/enterprise) — all of the above metrics are available in the console and via export.

What we will deliver by 2028-03-27:
1) SLO proofplaybook (PDF) — operational steps, query examples, export formats, retention policy (90 days retained for audit slices, 365 days retained full-resolution for internal debugging).
2) Historical evidence (CSV timeseries + summary) for us-west 90-day p95/p50 per-route.
3) Contract addendum draft with a temporary carveout template and a mitigation/fallback checklist.
4) A short runbook that auditors can use to reproduce calculations (PromQL examples + exact SQL used for exported summaries).

Next steps: please confirm what file formats work for your audit team (CSV vs parquet for timeseries) and whether we should include raw per-request logs (these are restricted by our data retention rules, but we can export aggregated slices). Also: will your legal team accept a Redwood-standard addendum (we'll send DocuSign link) or do you need tracked redlines up front?

Attaching: slo_proof_playbook_v1.pdf, historical-p95-timeseries.csv (sample)

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Solution Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment stubs: slo_proof_playbook_v1.pdf, historical-p95-timeseries.csv)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@orchidfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchid Financial Compliance <security@orchidfin.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API latency SLO proofpoints & audit playbook

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying asks from compliance: 

- We prefer CSV for the timeseries and would like a sample parquet if you store at that resolution.
- For historical evidence, can you include a per-route p95 timeseries and a single summary table that shows daily p50/p95 and whether each day met the commitment?
- Our auditors will want to see how you handle regional transient spikes. Please include an "exception/mutiny" chapter in the playbook that shows: detection thresholds, automated mitigations (fallback model, regional redirect), and a post-incident evidence package we can request.

On legal: we can start with your Redwood-standard addendum. If you can send a DocuSign link we will run it through procurement and circle back with any redlines.

Finally: can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the playbook and CSV export on 2028-03-24? Prefer 10:00–11:00 PT.

Best,
Emma

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@orchidfin.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API latency SLO proofpoints & audit playbook

Emma — confirmed for the walkthrough on 2028-03-24 at 10:00 PT. Sending a preliminary DocuSign addendum link now and a short exception playbook excerpt.

Exception / Spike playbook (excerpt):
- Detection: any per-route p95 measurement that exceeds the committed threshold by >30% for 3 consecutive 5-minute snapshots triggers an incident ticket and auto-mitigation.
- Auto-mitigations (ordered): 1) soft-fallback to a compatible lower-cost model variant (no data loss), 2) regional traffic steering to paired region (if region healthy and customer allows), 3) temporary increase in burst capacity for Dedicated-backed customers.
- Audit evidence bundle (post-incident): routing and request logs (aggregated 5-min buckets), snapshoted quantile calculations, autoscaler events, and a short RCA template with timestamps. We keep the evidence bundle components for 90 days; expanded artifacts (raw traces) retained 365 days for enterprise customers on request.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/r/redwood-addendum-orchid (draft)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ORCH-48291

I'll also include a CSV export as requested before the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Aditya

(Attachment stubs: addendum-draft.docx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: Hosted API latency SLO proofpoints & audit playbook

Internal follow-up: looping you in to coordinate deliverables for Orchid audit kickoff. Action items: 

- Lauren: confirm we can produce the per-route daily summary table and export at CSV parity by 3/27. Point of contact for the walkthrough.
- Ben: generate the 90-day p95 timeseries export for us-west and run a quick compliance check, note any days outside the p95 commitment. Attach the summary CSV to the HubSpot deal.
- Kimberly: prepare the exception playbook excerpt and the post-incident evidence template we discussed; we should include the exact PromQL and SQL queries auditors will run.

Please mark any blockers. We need to present the bundle during the 3/24 walkthrough and have the full package uploaded to the Drive link and HubSpot by EOD 3/27.

Thanks team,
Aditya
